verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs' own docs include conversation-flow settings that govern how the agent handles interruptions during speech and turn-taking, so barge-in is a first-party capability. The evidence describes only that these settings can be configured, not how the agent behaves when interrupted. Missing for 10: documentation that speech actually stops on barge-in, that context or the transcript is updated after an interruption, details of turn recovery, latency figures for interruption response, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on the agent to handle interruptions (barge-in) gracefully — stopping speech, updating context, and recovering the turn

citations.quote: Conversation flow settings determine how your assistant handles periods of user silence, interruptions during speech, and turn-taking behavior.
Configure turn-taking, interruptions, and timeout settings
